description: This file implements an HTML renderer for a markdown processing library, including functions for rendering various HTML elements, handling tags, and managing renderer state.

methods.name: hoedown_html_is_tag
methods.description: Checks if the given data matches a specific HTML tag name, returning the tag type.

methods.name: hoedown_html_toc_renderer_new
methods.description: Creates a new table of contents HTML renderer with specified nesting level.

methods.name: hoedown_html_renderer_new
methods.description: Creates a new HTML renderer with specified flags and nesting level.

methods.name: hoedown_html_renderer_free
methods.description: Frees the memory allocated for the HTML renderer.
